jobs.description:
Are you looking for an active, part-time job that keeps you moving? For a logistics company in the Woerden region, we are searching for an accurate sorting assistant who knows how to get things done. The working hours are from 11:30 AM till 3:30 PM. In this role, you will work together with your team to ensure all incoming shipments are prepared correctly for dispatch.
Unloading incoming delivery vans and trucks containing goods and large pallets.
Checking and sorting shipments (including chilled and fresh goods) by destination.
Sorting boxes and packages by postal code and specific collection routes.
Scanning and registering packages using a handheld scanner to update the system.
Identifying and reporting damaged goods or unreadable labels.
Keeping the depot floor clean, safe, and organized.
Our client specializes in fast parcel delivery for webshops, focusing on same-day, next-day, and fresh products. In their depot, they process various goods daily from standard parcels to chilled and fresh products to ensure fast and correct distribution.

To carry out these responsibilities effectively, you match the following profile.
Good physical condition to handle standing/walking work and package lifting.
Available Monday through Friday between 11:00 AM/12:00 PM and 3:30 PM.
Accurate work ethic to prevent incorrect routing or sorting errors.
Good command of either English or Dutch.

•    Experience with tenders or contract management is a plus

•    Competitive salary: €3.000 – €4.500 gross/month (based on 40 hours)

Since 1980, this company has been a trusted partner to international NGOs and governments, supporting healthcare delivery in developing countries.
